result.question: Why did God cause the leaders of Shechem to treat Abimelech deceitfully?

readings.answer: To bring the crime against the seventy sons of Jerubbaal to justice.
readings.support: in order that the crime against the seventy sons of Jerubbaal might come to justice

readings.answer: To avenge the blood of the seventy sons of Jerubbaal on Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem.
readings.support: and their blood be avenged on their brother Abimelech and on the leaders of Shechem

assessments.reason: It captures the stated purpose that the crime against Jerubbaal’s seventy sons come to justice (9:24) but omits the additional purpose that their blood be avenged on Abimelech and the leaders of Shechem.
It accurately states the avenging purpose and the agents (“on their brother Abimelech and on the leaders of Shechem,” 9:24) but omits the parallel purpose that the crime come to justice.
